SUBJECT: INTERNAL PANEL RESULTS FOR KOOL MILDS IMPROVEMENT SAMPLES/234

Internal smoke quality assessments of the KOOL MILDS improvement samples - Phase 3 is complete. These samples were fabricated in the Development Center August 27 and evaluated two weeks later.

Results indicate that the MacAndrews & Forbes SHIP BJSDLE has less irritation and more body than the International Planters Liquid Block Juice. SHIP BJSDLE also has better menthol and tobacco taste and is preferred significantly over the Liquid Block Juice.
SHIP BJSDLE/HALWAY has less impact and irritation than the HALWAY control. The HALWAY control is significantly preferred over current KOOL MILDS. Results also suggest that the use of ULLABON adds slightly more irritation and impact to the smoke and is not preferred.
From this work, three samples will be recommended for Dupont testing in Louisville and Connecticut. These are current KOOL MILDS (234179), HALWAY Control (234177), and SHIP/HALWAY (234175). Additionally, Newport FT should also be in the test. Note, all three samples are unflavored except for using 100% natural menthol.

Flavor development will begin using 234177 and 234175.
